newsitem.title: USA: Barney's Inc responds to Isetan statement.
newsitem.headline: Barney's Inc responds to Isetan statement.

text.p: Barney's Inc, in response to a statement by attorneys for Isetan Co Ltd stating complaints by Barney's Inc were "absurd", issued its own response.

"Hyperbole aside, the fact is that Isetan violated the terms of its licensing agreement for use of the Barneys New York name in Japan and Asia in not just one instance but several," said a spokesman for Barney's.
Barney's Inc said on September 19 it was seeking to terminate its license agreements with Barney's Japan and is also seeking to void certain Isetan security interests in Barney's.
"In addition, Isetan and its lawyers let its security interest in the royalty stream lapse in January 1995 and as a result Barney's is entitled to the royalties," said the spokesman for Barney's.
